concerns.concern: Only the resonator is calibrated by the aluminum-terminated control. The edge contacts and leads are not, so contact or lead inductance may contaminate the extracted kinetic inductance. The thick devices D10 to D12 sit two to three times above μ0λ²/d, which suggests a constant offset.
concerns.quote: the edge contacts and leads aren't calibrated

concerns.concern: The paper attributes the power-dependent frequency shift to microwave pair breaking, but quasiparticle heating or non-equilibrium quasiparticles could produce it. No measurement of frequency and Qi versus bath temperature is shown to tell the two apart, and no IQ-plane analysis is given.
concerns.quote: Measure fr and Qi of D6 versus bath temperature at −120 dBm and compare with the power shift

concerns.concern: The paper reads the current dependence of kinetic inductance as evidence of anisotropic nodeless pairing without comparing it to a conventional isotropic BCS gap. Data toward the critical current or versus temperature are needed for that comparison.
concerns.quote: Extend Fig. 3f toward I* ≈ 0.4 mA, or measure Lk(T), and compare with the isotropic BCS form

concerns.concern: The clean- to dirty-limit crossover slope in Fig. 4c may depend on including a literature monolayer point and on assigning D1 a thickness different from the 1.5 layers indicated by Raman. Its robustness to these choices is not shown.
concerns.quote: how does the Fig. 4c slope change without the literature monolayer point or with D1 at the 1.5 layers Raman gives

concerns.concern: The photon-number calibration in Eq. 5 is not explained, including line attenuation, Qc and the uncertainty. The reported self-Kerr coefficients depend on it.
concerns.quote: How did you calibrate the photon number in Eq. 5 (line attenuation and Qc), with what uncertainty

concerns.concern: The rising internal quality factor in Fig. S4c appears inconsistent with the linewidth broadening reported in the text.
concerns.quote: How do the rising Qi of Fig. S4c and the linewidth broadening reported on p. 27 fit together?

concerns.concern: The paper does not say how many resonators were fabricated or cooled, how many gave usable resonances, or why some were set aside.
concerns.quote: the number fabricated and set aside isn't given

concerns.concern: Some devices in Table 1 are left out of the figures without explanation: D10 to D12 from Fig. 4a, and D6, D7 and D9 to D12 from Fig. 4c.
concerns.quote: why are D10 to D12 absent from Fig. 4a and D6, D7 and D9 to D12 absent from Fig. 4c?

concerns.concern: Power and DC-bias sweeps are shown only for one representative device (D6). A second device, such as D1 with the largest Kerr coefficient, should also be shown.
concerns.quote: show the Fig. 3 sweeps for D1 or D2

concerns.concern: The paper does not disclose the full measured ranges or why the shown ranges were chosen. All microwave data are at 10 mK, and it is unclear whether higher powers or larger DC biases were measured.
concerns.quote: Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: bath temperatures above 10 mK, powers above −80 dBm, and DC bias beyond the 15 µA

concerns.concern: The authors should report the spread in control-resonator frequency for identical designs and say whether each aluminum control sits on the same chip as its NbSe2 resonator.
concerns.quote: Is each Al-terminated control on the same chip as its NbSe2 resonator, how far does fr,Al spread for identical designs

concerns.concern: It is unclear which sample corresponds to each row of Table S3. The 7-layer row could not be matched to any entry in Table S1.
concerns.quote: Which sample gives each row of Table S3 (I could not find the 7-layer row in Table S1)

concerns.concern: The meaning of the error bars in Fig. 4 is not stated.
concerns.quote: what do the error bars in Fig. 4 represent?

concerns.concern: The text says DC bias was applied up to 30 µA, but the axis of Fig. 3e,f extends only to 15 µA.
concerns.quote: the text's "up to IDC = 30 µA" (p. 6) differs from the 15 µA axis of Fig. 3e,f

concerns.concern: Data are available only on request and no analysis code is provided.
concerns.quote: data are "available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request" (p. 22), with no code

concerns.concern: A tick label in Fig. 3c appears to be wrong.
concerns.quote: The lowest tick in Fig. 3c reads −1.15 MHz; from the spacing it looks like −0.15.
